topic: Penal Compounding Prohibition under RBI Regulations
storedFact: RBI guidelines dated 18 Aug 2023 prohibit banking institutions and NBFCs from compounding penal charges or capitalizing them into principal. Penal charges must be levied separately.
anonymizedQuery: Can financial institutions capitalize penal interest into principal outstanding under Indian banking law?

topic: Agricultural to Non-Agricultural Conversion Norms (Maharashtra Land Revenue Code)
storedFact: Section 44 of Maharashtra Land Revenue Code 1966 governs NA conversion. Once NA order is issued and nazrana/conversion charges paid, agricultural tenancy claims cannot be reopened under Section 32G of Bombay Tenancy Act.
anonymizedQuery: Effect of Section 44 NA conversion on prior tenancy proceedings under Maharashtra Land Revenue Code.

topic: GST Liability Timing on Joint Development Agreements (JDA)
storedFact: Notification 4/2018-Central Tax (Rate) defers GST liability on development rights transferred by a landowner to a developer until the date of issuance of the completion certificate or first occupation.
anonymizedQuery: When does GST liability trigger for developer on transfer of development rights under JDA?

storedFact: Under Regulation 30A of IBBI Regulations, withdrawal of CIRP petition can be made prior to constitution of CoC with consent of operational creditor upon filing Form FA before NCLT.
anonymizedQuery: Procedure for withdrawal of Section 9 petition before constitution of Committee of Creditors.
